notes: Use alsjeblieft when talking to friends, children, or people on a first-name basis. Use alstublieft when being formal or speaking to strangers and older people.
It has three main everyday uses: saying 'please' when asking for something, saying 'here you go' when handing something over, and saying 'you're welcome' in reply to a thank you.

senses.definition: Used to be polite when asking for something.

senses.definition: Said in reply when someone thanks you.
